_meta.note: Per decision: behavioral_target (what the checker scores, wording-blind), checker_id, native_framing, canonical (the v3 leading clause), and paraphrases {positive, negation}. Only the leading instruction clause is swapped at build; the codebase justification + 'Read <module>' tail stay constant. POS = pure positive (no prohibition); NEG = pure negation (don't/never/avoid/no). Length/specificity balanced within each polarity so is_negation isn't confounded with verbosity. 9 flippable + 3 excluded (language-irreducible).

architecture_extend.excluded_reason: Base-class modification is undetectable from the response snippet (no base in scope). A standalone function satisfies the negation but not the positive -> no clean binary.

code_style_listcomp.excluded_reason: A plain for-loop satisfies 'don't use map/filter' but not 'use a comprehension' -> positive and negation target different compliant sets; no clean binary.
